status.busy: Working: {action} — waiting for TrueNAS to finish.
status.pending: An earlier operation may still be running. Controls are locked until its outcome is known.
status.offline_help: Check your SSH settings, key or agent, and known-hosts entry. Last successful readings are retained when the connection drops.
status.refresh_help: Refresh to load the current server inventory.
status.truncated: This inventory was limited for responsiveness. Use the TrueNAS web interface for the full list.

widget.hint: Click: command center · Right-click: refresh · Middle-click: settings

metrics.arc_help: Reclaimable cache · not added to RAM usage
metrics.network_help: Receive ↓ / Send ↑ · rates appear after two readings

apps.empty_help: Change your search, state filter, or configured favorite/hidden app lists.
apps.help: Play: start · Stop: stop · Refresh: restart without pulling newer images. Favorites are configured in settings.

storage.help: Pool capacity is reported by ZFS. Dataset quotas and filesystem overhead may differ from these totals.

alerts.cached_empty: No active alerts in the last successful reading
alerts.help: Dismissed historical alerts are excluded. Nothing is automatically dismissed or changed on your server.

confirm.title: {action} {app}?
confirm.stop: This will interrupt the application and its active connections. The server and your other apps will remain running.
confirm.restart: This will stop the app, wait for TrueNAS to confirm the stop, then start it again. There will be downtime. No image updates will be pulled.

server_name.label: Server display name
server_name.description: A friendly name for the panel and top-bar tooltip.

ssh_host.label: SSH host
ssh_host.description: IP address or hostname only, not a URL or user@host. The server must already be trusted in SSH known_hosts.

ssh_user.label: SSH user
ssh_user.description: An account authorized to run the required TrueNAS middleware operations. Root has full server privileges.

ssh_port.label: SSH port
ssh_port.description: The SSH listener port on the NAS.

ssh_identity.label: SSH identity file
ssh_identity.description: Optional absolute or ~/ private-key path. Leave empty to use your SSH agent and normal identities. No key contents are stored here.

web_url.label: Web interface URL
web_url.description: HTTP(S) address opened by the dashboard shortcut. Keep this in sync when changing the SSH host.

network_interface.label: Network interface
network_interface.description: One server interface, such as br1. Do not sum a bridge and its physical member or traffic will be double-counted.

refresh_interval.label: Live statistics interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: CPU, RAM, sensors and network refresh cadence. Failed connections back off automatically.

inventory_interval.label: App/storage inventory interval (seconds)
inventory_interval.description: Slower refresh cadence for application state, pools and alerts. Opening the panel forces a refresh.

request_timeout.label: Read request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout.description: Deadline for SSH collection. Offline servers never block the desktop UI.

action_timeout.label: App operation timeout (seconds)
action_timeout.description: Maximum wait for start/stop/restart jobs. A timeout is not a cancellation; unknown outcomes lock further controls.

stale_after.label: Stale data threshold (seconds)
stale_after.description: Disable management controls when readings are this old. Choose a value longer than your live refresh interval.

read_only.label: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Disable every app mutation while retaining telemetry, inventory, and web shortcuts.

confirm_stop.label: Confirm Stop
confirm_stop.description: Show the application and destination before interrupting an app. Recommended.

confirm_restart.label: Confirm Restart
confirm_restart.description: Require explicit confirmation before stopping and starting an app. Recommended.

favorites.label: Favorite applications
favorites.description: Comma-separated exact app names. Favorites sort first and can be filtered using the star button.

hidden_apps.label: Hidden applications
hidden_apps.description: Comma-separated exact app names to omit from the app list. This is a display preference, not an access-control boundary.

notify_actions.label: App operation notifications
notify_actions.description: Show a desktop notification when an app operation succeeds, fails, or has an unknown outcome.

show_temperature.label: Show CPU temperature
show_temperature.description: Hide this card if your server has no supported temperature sensor.

show_network.label: Show network transfer
show_network.description: Display receive/send rates for the selected server interface.

show_arc.label: Show ZFS ARC cache
show_arc.description: Display the cache separately; RAM used is total minus available memory.

bar_metric.label: Top-bar reading
bar_metric.description: Choose which compact statistic appears beside the server icon.

bar_color.label: Top-bar accent
bar_color.description: Use a semantic Noctalia palette color. Automatically follows light/dark theme changes.
